MRI Safety Information
The Willow Embolization Coil System is MR Conditional. A person with the Willow Embolization Coil System may be safely scanned under the following conditions. Failure to follow these conditions may result in injury.
Parameter Condition
Device Name Willow Embolization Coil System
Static Magnetic Field Strength (B0) 1.5 T or 3 T
B0 Field Orientation Horizontal
Maximum Spatial Field Gradient 2500 gauss/cm (25 T/m)
RF Transmit Coil Type Body transmit coil only
Operating Mode Normal Operating Mode or First Level Controlled Operating Mode
RF Conditions Maximum Whole-Body SAR 4 W/kg
Image Artifact The image artifact extends approximately 3 mm from the device.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
